# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(forcats)
```

# 2. Load data
```{r}
base_dir <- "/Users/karenshih/Documents/research/scg/protein-master/v2_pancan_batch_corrected"
data_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "analysis/04_enrichment/ora")
df <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "kegg_ora_tmb_up_non_pqc.csv"))
```

# 3. Clean + prepare data
```{r}
df_clean <- df %>%
  filter(category != "Human Diseases") %>%
  filter(!subcategory %in% c(
    "Global and overview maps",
    "Transport and catabolism",
    "Endocrine system"
  )) %>%
  filter(!Description %in% c(
    "Oocyte meiosis",
    "Progesterone-mediated oocyte maturation"
  )) %>%
   filter(!subcategory %in% c(
    "Environmental adaptation"
   ))
```

```{r}
unique(df_clean$subcategory)
```

```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      # 🔥 PQC
      subcategory == "Folding, sorting and degradation" ~ "Protein quality control (PQC)",
      
      # 🧬 DNA
      subcategory == "Replication and repair" ~ "DNA replication and repair",
      
      # ⚡ All metabolism collapsed
      subcategory %in% c(
        "Energy metabolism",
        "Carbohydrate metabolism",
        "Metabolism of terpenoids and polyketides",
        "Glycan biosynthesis and metabolism",
        "Amino acid metabolism"
      ) ~ "Metabolism",
      
      # 🛡️ Immune
      subcategory == "Immune system" ~ "Immune",
      
      # everything else stays the same
      TRUE ~ subcategory
    )
  )
```

# 5. Order + palette
```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c(
      "Protein quality control (PQC)",
      "Translation",
      "Transcription",
      "DNA replication and repair",
      "Cell growth and death",
      "Metabolism",
      "Immune"
    ))
  )
```

```{r}
category_order <- c(
  "Protein quality control (PQC)",
  "Translation",
  "Transcription",
  "DNA replication and repair",
  "Cell growth and death",
  "Metabolism",
  "Immune",
  "Other"
)
```

```{r}
palette <- c(
  "Protein quality control (PQC)" = "#D55E00",   # 🔥 strong orange/red (highlight)
  "Translation"                  = "#1b9e77",   # green
  "Transcription"                = "#377eb8",   # blue
  "DNA replication and repair"   = "#984ea3",   # purple
  "Cell growth and death"        = "#f781bf",   # pink
  "Metabolism"                   = "#ff7f00",   # orange
  "Immune"                       = "#e41a1c",   # red
  "Other"                        = "gray70"     # muted
)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = category_order),
    Description = fct_reorder(Description, neglogP)
  )
```

# 6. Plot by functional category
```{r}
p_category <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = neglogP, y = Description, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +

  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray40",
             size = 0.6) +

  labs(
    x = "-log10(FDR)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment\nAll TMB-Associated Genes Minus PQC Genes",
    subtitle = "Colored by functional category; dashed line indicates FDR = 0.05"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines")
  )
```
```{r}
p_category
```


```{r}
fout = file.path(base_dir, "results/figures/main/fig1/kegg_ora_by_function_no_pqc_genes.pdf")
ggsave(fout, p_category, width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
